kind: Explicit FP32 attention accuracy experiment; no performance measurement; no default promotion

storage: BF16 X, weights, Q/K/V, cache, GQA output, Wo output, residual output

contract.authority: actual pinned Qwen2SdpaAttention with explicit FP32 SDPA inputs and BF16 output
contract.storage: BF16 X, weights, Q/K/V, cache, GQA output, Wo output, residual output
contract.attention_intermediates: FP32 scaled scores, softmax, and probability-times-V accumulation
contract.cache: exact copies, prefix preservation and unused capacity poison
contract.eager: retained as a separate compatibility comparison; existing gates unchanged
contract.numpy_fp64: independent diagnostic on identical captured Q/K/V
contract.promotion: experimental route; no default arithmetic change or performance claim

fp32_upstream_contract.attention_boundary: explicit FP32 Q/K/V and mask; result rounded to BF16 before Wo

routes.2: split64 H4 decode / rolled QK MMA prefill

asynchronous.driver:
from test_attention_sublayer import test_repeated_asynchronous_use

def main() raises:
    test_repeated_asynchronous_use()
    print("All four attention routes passed normal asynchronous reuse")
asynchronous.command: env -u MODULAR_DEBUG uv run --locked mojo run -D SUBLAYER_REPEAT=12 -I src -I build -I tests build/attention_async_check.mojo

reproducer.checkpoint: uv run --script tests/fixtures/attention_sublayer/checkpoint.py --attention-prefix; uv run --locked mojo run -D PRECISION_CHECKPOINT=1 -I src -I build -I tests tests/test_attention_precision.mojo
